verdict.rationale: Justworks has an Analytics > Custom Payroll Report that admins use to review employees' payroll information before running payroll, so a payroll reporting surface exists. The evidence never describes what the report contains or whether it can be exported. The Xero integration maps pay types to accounts for accounting sync, but that is not a report export for analysis. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net breakdown (earnings, taxes, deductions to net), export formats (CSV/XLSX), documented report fields/filters, independent corroboration.
